$description: Design tokens for the AI Career Intelligence Mentor Platform (PRD v1.4.1 / UI-UX Spec v2.0.2). Primitive palette derived in OKLCH and WCAG 2.1 AA contrast-verified (see design-tokens.audit.json). Semantic themes: light (default) and dark. Bangla-first typography per Spec §8.

com.example.governance.paletteGeneration: OKLCH constant-hue ramps, sRGB gamut-mapped, AA-audited

sans.$description: Bangla-first body/UI stack. Hind Siliguri primary Bangla; Inter renders Latin at matching x-height.

display.$description: Headings; same family rendered at heavier weights for mixed-script harmony.

mono.$description: Code, SQL, config, test-case quiz answers (PRD §29). Line numbers on.

md.$description: Default body size; 16px avoids iOS zoom-on-focus.

relaxed.$description: Long-form reading (topic explanations). Bangla requires generous leading.

touch-target-min.$description: WCAG 2.5.5 / spec §2 minimum hit area on mobile.

slow.$description: Bottom sheets, modals. Suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.
